CREATE TABLE bank_sync_states (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	account_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	encrypted_credentials TEXT, 
	checkpoint JSON NOT NULL, 
	last_received_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	last_success_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	error_code VARCHAR(64), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (user_id, provider, account_key)
)

CREATE TABLE job_leases (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	token VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	lease_until TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	next_due TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	last_success TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	failure_code VARCHAR(64), 
	checkpoint JSON NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (user_id, name)
)

CREATE TABLE operational_alerts (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	account_id VARCHAR(36), 
	rule VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	rule_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	severity VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	deduplication_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	evidence_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	observed_value VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	threshold VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	message VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	cooldown_until TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	occurrences INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	delivery_status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	delivery_error VARCHAR(64), 
	acknowledged_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	resolved_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (user_id, deduplication_key)
)
